messages:
Maya (AE): Quick sync — Lexify wants a short POC to validate their contract-search assistant. Key asks: EU-only storage, DB tool calls to their internal PG, and verifying that embeddings+reranker handle long contracts (~45k tokens). They want success criteria + a two-week plan.
Ravi (SE): Noted. Clarify: do they expect single-pass 45k context? Or are they ok with retrieval+rerank?
Maya (AE): They wrote 'preserve clause order and context; prefer single-response if possible'.
Arun (ML): Single-pass 45k is outside our hosted 32k models. Two realistic approaches: 1) Retrieval pipeline with chunking (overlap) + cross-encoder rerank; 2) Private/Dedicated deployment using a 64k-variant they host. For POC, retrieval+rerank is faster to show value.
Lena (Security): Requirements I'll need: EU residency for vector index and logs, SAML SSO for console, evidence of SOC2, and KMS integration for key rotation. Also check if DB connectors can be restricted to their private IPs.
Cass (Solutions): Proposed 2-week POC outline: Week 0: kickoff + security Qs + sample data ingest (10 representative contracts). Week 1: build index (embeddings) + baseline retrieval. Week 2: add cross-encoder reranker, run 200 eval queries, tune prompts, produce report. Deliverables: ingestion summary, precision@10 & recall@20, MRR, latency percentiles, and recommended infra.
Ravi (SE): Cost frame: Hosted for 2-week eval (low tps) ~ $2k–4k. Dedicated trial (short-term reserved) requires comms with sales ops, ballpark $15k/month minimum. Private on-prem deviates by infra. I'll get more exact numbers.
Maya (AE): Lexify infra lead insists on DB tool-calls to PG with parameterized queries. Can we support tool calling in hosted safely?
Ravi (SE): We support function/tool calling but hosted outbound network is restricted. For secure DB reads, recommended options: 1) Private deployment with connector inside their VPC, 2) For hosted POC, use a proxy we host that talks to their DB over a whitelist/VPN for the trial. We'll need an access checklist.
Arun (ML): On metrics: aim for MRR >= 0.65 on legal queries, F1 on extraction tasks >= 0.8 (if they extract clauses), and end-to-end 95th latency < 500ms for hosted baseline. Cross-encoder for top-30 should raise MRR but increases latency — consider batching and async rerank if needed.
Cass (Solutions): Example eval command to include in playbook: ```bash
# run end-to-end eval
python tools/e2e_eval.py --index lexify_idx --queries test_queries.json --embed-model rwd-embed-1536 --rerank-model cross-legal-small --topk 30 --out results.csv
```
Arun (ML): Sample reranker prompt (legal): ```
"Given the user question and candidate passage, output JSON {score:0-1, rationale:string}. Prefer exact clause matches and consider temporal precedence. Keep rationale short."```
Lena (Security): I'll also ask legal: any PII policy for ingest. Hosted logs are redacted by default but we can offer private for strict no-forwarding. I'll compile the security answers in 72h.
Maya (AE): Lexify asked for a one-page summary they can share with their legal/compliance team. Cass can you draft that?
Cass (Solutions): Yep — one-pager with architecture options (hosted/proxy vs. dedicated vs. private), security checklist, timeline, and sample success metrics. I'll include an appendix with the eval command and reranker prompt.
Ravi (SE): Ops config suggestion: a canary route and fallback to a quantized smaller model if load spikes. Example snippet to share: ```json
{"routes": [{"name":"lexify-primary","model":"rwd-32k-v2","fallback":"rwd-8k-quant"}], "batching":{"max_tokens":1024}} 
```
infra-bot: sandbox workspace provisioned at 1941234680 — credentials invite sent to Lexify test user.
Maya (AE): Action list: Cass -> one-pager & ingest guide by EOD; Lena -> security questionnaire + docs in 72h; Ravi -> cost ranges + proxy checklist; Arun -> baseline eval scripts and small test set. I'll propose kickoff Thursday. :rocket:
Ravi (SE): I'll prepare the proxy checklist and cost ranges.
Cass (Solutions): Drafting one-pager now, will post link here.
Lena (Security): Starting questionnaire review — will coordinate for EU residency details.
Arun (ML): I'll seed the test queries and a simple scoring harness.
Maya (AE): Thanks team — will send Lexify this thread summary after Cass posts the playbook. :thumbsup:
